item.title: One Dead, Dozens Kidnapped as Bandits Hit Zamfara Communities
item.description: Armed bandits launched multiple raids across Zurmi and Bungudu Local Government Areas of Zamfara State between Saturday night and Monday afternoon, leaving one person dead and at least 27 others abducted, security sources confirmed.The first attack struck Tungar Tsamiya village in Moriki District, Zurmi LGA, around 10:40 p.m. on November 30.
